source_instruction: i would like some champagne rhinestones for my nail art.
query: Oh man, I just got back from walking my golden retriever and he rolled in a huge patch of mud by the community garden, so I had to give him a sudsy bath on the porch and now my favorite fuzzy slippers are soaked through, plus I noticed my windowsill succulent is getting all wrinkly like I forgot to water it for two whole weeks. Anyway, since you probably don’t have any makeup sets with nail art in stock right now, can you grab me the ones with champagne-themed accents that are under $50? Wait, actually make sure they’re the ones that come with nail art too, yeah?
